class.name: visual_avoidance_controller::VisualAvoidanceController
class.description:
Nav2 controller plugin that wraps RegulatedPurePursuitController and adds visual-based reactive obstacle avoidance.
Subscribes to a geometry_msgs/PoseArray on `/obstacle_info` (default) and runs a cone-zone state machine. Algorithm ports the senior-team's Cone_Judgement / avoidObstacle logic from C++.
Parameters (all under the plugin's namespace, e.g. "VisualRPP"): obstacle_topic (string, default "/obstacle_info") cone_zone_a (double, default 75.0) cone_zone_b (double, default 20.0) cone_zone_c (double, default 12.0) avoid_R (double, default 0.35) -- far avoidance radius avoid_bigR (double, default 0.45) -- near avoidance radius y_threshold (double, default 0.75) -- front distance cutoff offset_x_first_half (double, default -0.12) -- turn threshold (early) offset_x_second_half (double, default -0.08) -- turn threshold (late) recovery_duration (double, default 0.58) -- sec, after obstacle clears avoid_linear_vel (double, default 0.4) -- m/s while avoiding max_angular_vel (double, default 1.0) -- rad/s while avoiding enable_visual_avoidance (bool, default true)
